newsitem.title: BELGIUM: European Air Shippers Council appoints new chairman.
newsitem.headline: European Air Shippers Council appoints new chairman.

text.p: The European Air Shippers' Council has appointed Knut Hansen, managing director of Distrilux International AB, as its new chairman.
Distrilux is the distribution company for Swedish multi- national company, Electrolux.

EASC secretary, Chris Welsh, said that Hansen has had a wide range of managerial experience with Volvo Penta and Electrolux. He was previously group controller of Lehel-Electrolux Hungary and he was appointed managing director of Distrilux earlier this year.
Hansen is also a member of the Swedish Shippers' Council and takes over from John Boyce of Amersham International Plc who had been EASC chairman for four years.
Boyce is taking up the position of regional U.K. director of Amersham.
Michel Abgrall-Levy, transport and quality manager for Groupe Schneider since 1991, has been appointed vice-chairman of the EASC.
He is also a member of the French Shippers' Council, AUTF.
EASC includes membership from ten national shippers' councils throughout Europe and Israel. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
